# The ZAO app

> The ZAO's lean public client at zaoos.com, built on Farcaster: the ZAO feed, casting, replies, and a song player for music shared in casts.

## What The ZAO is

The ZAO (ZTalent Artist Organization) is a decentralized impact network that returns profit margin, data and IP rights to artists using emerging technology. Its first artist domain is music. It is not a record label. Founded by Zaal Panthaki (BetterCallZaal).

## What the app does (v1)

- Sign in with a Farcaster account
- Read and post to The ZAO's channel feed, with replies
- Play songs and music cards shared inside casts
- Notifications, settings, and a Farcaster mini app entry at https://zaoos.com/miniapp

Left out of v1 on purpose: direct messages, wallet login, governance proposals, and cross-posting.

## Governance, in brief

- Respect is The ZAO's on-chain contribution record: an OG ERC-20 and a ZOR ERC-1155, both on Optimism.
- A weekly Respect Game ranks contributions. It has met weekly since 2024-07-30, and results have settled on-chain in 72 distinct weeks as of 2026-10-12. No unbroken on-chain streak is claimed.
- 165 unique Respect holders, read from Optimism on 2026-10-12.
